body.value: The unique characteristics of the utamakura. Geographical information, famous landmarks, temples and shrines, or famous classics that are central when discussing the particular utamakura (e.g. in the case of "Akashi" The Tale of Genji) are given. If there is nothing of particular to note, it may be left blank. Mainly Katagiri Yōichi's Utamakura utakotoba jiten was consulted for reference.
